synthesis_points: release tracking belongs in small receipts rather than assumptions
MCP/app-server style routing must minimize scopes and avoid token passthrough patterns
status receipts should support operational debugging without exposing raw prompts, outputs, paths, or private transport
local and network access modes should be treated as topology choices with explicit trust boundaries
future THOS runner design should separate launch, watch, completion, quality, redaction, and marker-review responsibilities
